references.text: The description of how the menorah (lampstand) was to be made, with detailed instructions given to Moses on Mount Sinai, including that it should be made of hammered gold.
The Lord instructs Moses to make the tabernacle and all its equipment exactly according to the pattern shown to him on the mountain.
Bezalel makes the lampstand from hammered gold in accordance with the pattern the Lord had shown Moses.
Specific instruction that the lampstand was to be made of a single piece of hammered gold, as referenced in Numbers 8:4.

The author of Hebrews refers to priests serving in a sanctuary that is a copy and shadow of the heavenly one, and notes that Moses was warned to make everything according to the pattern shown to him on the mountain.
